vulnerable.description: exec() replaced by compile() followed by eval() of the compiled code object, which runs the same statements. Still runs model output.

control.description: Identical to the base control: the chart is chosen from the data types only.

data_flow.source: LLM completion: plotly code generated from a prompt that contains the user's question (simulated in the harness).

validation.summary: Same behavioural test as the base case, run on this variant: the attack works only on the vulnerable file and normal use works on both.

assumptions: An attacker can influence the generated plotly code through the question (prompt injection), as shown for CVE-2024-5565.
limitations: No live LLM inference is run; the malicious model output is simulated.
The repair removes LLM-chosen chart styles; this is a functional trade-off, also made by Vanna 2.x.
The question is also placed in the system prompt (a separate LLM01 issue), which is not part of this case.
Vanna 2.x replaced this code; the case uses the legacy module still shipped at this commit.
Refactored variant of vanna_plotly_exec_001: same application group and same split; it is not an independent sample.
